note: General Drawing Information (decisions 2026-10-19 / 10-20): the job number (required) and the item name (from Arena: pasted for now, fetched later). How they reach the title block of the HYPER_A template.
drawing_number_note: Shown in the app's preview only. In the drawing, the template's own fields build FGD (900-) and each row's drawing number (EO-/ES-/EW-) from the FG NUMBER drawing property.
item_name_note: The item name goes on two title block lines. If it is longer than item_name_line_length characters it is split at the comma nearest the middle.
drawing_properties_note: Drawing properties (DWGPROPS custom properties) in HYPER_A; fields in its title block show them on every sheet. total_pages is the drawing's whole page count (TOC, legend, BOM and the ES pages), shown as the title block's "OF nn" (decision 2026-11-11; was the ES pages only).
